provenance.ballPolicy: Leo’s basketball follows his right-hand approach, takeoff, rise and power finish as a separate runtime object. Release once from the open right palm at frame10/tick21. No ball is painted into the sprite sheet.

cleanup.method: inspect fifteen 5x3 poses and isolate alpha-connected bodies with nearest antialiased pixels; pack 128x96 baseline94 WebP cells

review.reviewNotes: Fifteen complete right-facing poses show an approach, gather, takeoff, powerful one-hand rise, open-hand release at frame10/tick21, follow-through and landing. Leo remains pale, adult and human with long wavy black hair, refined mustache and black/crimson kit. Both hands are empty and no ball is painted.

provenance.packaging: package-dunk15.py --isolate-components; 128x96 cells; baseline94; WebP88; no generated extra frames
